title: Important Notice: Binance Wallet SPCXx IPO Campaign Cancellation and Next Steps
text: This is a general announcement. The products and services referred to herein may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We thank the community for the interest in the Binance Wallet SPCXx IPO Campaign. Due to circumstances outside of our control, we are unable to proceed with this campaign. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We have arranged the following solutions: 1. Full Refund All locked USDC from participating users will be fully refunded to your Binance Wallet via the original payment method. No action is required on your part. Refunds are being processed in batches and we aim to complete these by  2026-06-12 . 2. $1,000,000 SPCXB Airdrop As a token of appreciation for participating users, we will distribute a total of  $1,000,000 worth of bStocks SpaceX tokens (SPCXB)  equally to all users who participated in this campaign. The airdrop will be automatically credited to participating users’ Binance Spot Accounts  by 2026-06-18 . No action is required. What Is SPCXB: SPCXB is an upcoming bStocks token - a digital asset designed to track the price of SpaceX shares, backed 1:1 by real SpaceX shares held by a regulated custodian, with publicly verifiable proof of reserves.  SPCXB will soon be available for trading on Binance Spot — stay tuned. 3. Trade SpaceX Stock (SPCX) on Binance Binance now supports trading of more than 7,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs, including many of the world's most recognised companies. No need to wait — you can now submit whole-share, regular trading hours limit orders for SpaceX (SPCX) stock on Binance. Once again, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by the cancellation of this campaign. Thank you for your continued trust and support of Binance.
